body.en: When you want an agent's help directly inside your editor, having to open an interface by hand first often adds an extra step. Now `muse acp` is turned on by default, so editors that support the Agent Client Protocol (a standard way for editors and agents to communicate), such as Zed, can run Muse directly as their agent. When you open Zed to edit your notes or code, you can assign tasks to Muse right away without flipping another switch, though this surface is still experimental and may change in a later release. ⟦A newly bought device ships with a universal adapter already plugged in—previously you had to wire it up and flip a switch to pair, whereas now any editor with that same socket connects right away.⟧

items.original: `muse acp` is on by default, so editors that support the Agent Client Protocol (like Zed) can run Muse as their agent; the surface is experimental and may change in a later release

title.zh-TW: 支援以 prompt.surfaces 與空白設定關閉開發者提示詞
title.en: Turn off developer prompts with prompt.surfaces and blank settings

body.zh-TW: 對話剛起步時若想關掉一部分預設提示，過去較難照個別需要一一拿掉。在全域或專案設定裡加入 `prompt.surfaces`（可附帶選用的 `default` 預設值），或是透過工作階段設定覆寫，就能依 ID 關閉指定的開發者提示詞區塊。目前有五個受保護的區塊會繼續維持開啟，如果設定裡填了不認識的 ID，啟動時會跳過並顯示通知，而由工作階段直接送出未知 ID 則會遭到拒絕。當你想在特定專注寫作的工作階段完全退出 Muse 內建的開發者脈絡，只要在工作階段設定中把 `developerPrompt` 設為 `null` 或空字串即可。⟦跟點餐時勾選客製化選項一樣，以前固定配料會整盤端上桌，現在能按編號拿掉不要的區塊，或乾脆整份不加預設底料。⟧
body.en: When starting a conversation, turning off only part of the default prompts used to be hard to tailor piece by piece. Add `prompt.surfaces` (with an optional `default`) to global or project settings, or override it in session settings, to turn off specific developer-prompt blocks by ID. Five protected blocks stay on for now; an unrecognized ID in settings is skipped with a startup notice, while sending an unknown ID directly from a session is refused. When you want a focused writing session to opt out of Muse's built-in developer context completely, set `developerPrompt` to `null` or an empty string in that session's config. ⟦Like checking custom options when ordering a meal, fixed toppings used to arrive all at once on the plate, whereas now you can remove unwanted items by number or skip the default base altogether.⟧

items.original:
A `prompt.surfaces` setting turns developer-prompt blocks off by id (with an optional `default`) in global or project settings, and per session through session settings overrides; the five protected blocks stay on for now, and an unknown id is skipped with a startup notice (refused when a session sends it)
Setting `developerPrompt` to a null or empty value in a session config now opts that session out of Muse's own developer context

title.zh-TW: 重開終端機工作階段可保存並套用新版開發者指令
title.en: Reopened terminal sessions save and apply updated developer instructions

body.zh-TW: 中斷對話後想改掉背景規範再接著聊，以前重開工作階段往往還是沿用舊指令。現在每次工作階段啟動時都會先記錄開發者指令，只要你在設定裡修改 `run.developer_prompt`，再於終端機透過 `--resume`、`--continue` 或 `tbh exec --session-id` 重開工作階段，Muse 就會存下新版內容並從下一輪開始套用。對於由這一版建立或更新過開發者指令的工作階段，若某次執行正處於第一步，遠端的傳送、開啟、列表或輪詢操作可能會等到該步驟的檢查點完成，但絕不會超過呼叫本身的期限。其他既有工作階段則不受影響，不過現在新建立的工作階段無法用關閉此功能的舊版本開啟。⟦就像登機前先在櫃檯建檔規範，修改後重辦登機便會換上新版，起飛第一步完成前遠端查詢會稍等檢查紀錄，只是舊版閘門還讀不懂新檔案。⟧
body.en: If you paused a conversation and wanted to change its background guidelines before continuing, reopening the session used to keep the old instructions. Muse now records developer instructions each time a session starts, so when you edit `run.developer_prompt` in your settings and reopen the session in the terminal with `--resume`, `--continue`, or `tbh exec --session-id`, it saves the new text and applies it from the next turn. On a session whose developer instructions were created or updated by this release, a remote send, open, list, or poll made while a run is in its first step may wait until that step's checkpoint finishes, never past the call's own deadline. Other existing sessions are unaffected, though sessions created now cannot be opened by an older build that has this feature turned off. ⟦Think of filing guidelines at the check-in counter before boarding: updating them and checking in again switches to the new version, remote inquiries wait briefly for the checkpoint before the first step of takeoff finishes, and older gates cannot read the new file yet.⟧

items.original: Muse now records each session's developer instructions when it starts. When you reopen a session in the terminal (`--resume`, `--continue` or `tbh exec --session-id`) after changing `run.developer_prompt` in your settings, Muse saves the new text and uses it from the next turn. On a session whose developer instructions were set by this release's start or update, a remote send, open, list or poll made while a run is in its first step can wait until that step's checkpoint, never past the call's own deadline; other sessions see no change. Sessions created now cannot be opened by an older build that has this off

title.zh-TW: 工作階段語言鎖定改依使用者訊息於首段輸出宣告
title.en: Session language pin now declared from first output based on user messages

body.zh-TW: 專案夾雜大量英文程式碼或名詞時，你可能擔心對話回覆被裡頭的字詞帶偏語言。⟦好比飯店櫃檯直接聽住客本人說什麼語言就用那種語言回應，而不是看護照夾裡的英文備註或行李標籤亂猜，從第一句問候就說對語言，住客還沒開口前則先用英文招呼。⟧在符合條件的主執行流程中，Muse 現在會從第一段可見輸出就明確宣告你的工作階段語言釘選（鎖定這段對話該使用的回覆語言）。這個語言設定會固定依據你在該工作階段發送的訊息推算出來，不會再從名稱、程式碼或工具輸出推斷語言。當你輸入的內容還沒有明顯語言訊號時，則會採用英文作為預設語言。
body.en: When a project mixes in lots of English code or terms, you might worry that replies will be swayed by those words into the wrong language. ⟦Picture a hotel front desk listening directly to what the guest speaks and replying in kind rather than guessing from English notes in a passport holder or luggage tags, getting the greeting right from the first word and defaulting to English before the guest speaks.⟧ On eligible main runs, Muse now explicitly states your session language pin (which locks the reply choice for this conversation) from the first visible output. This language setting is derived deterministically from the messages you send in the session, rather than inferred from names, code, or tool output. When your input carries no clear language signal yet, English is used as the default.

items.original: Muse now states your session language pin on eligible main runs from the first visible output, deriving the pin deterministically from your own messages in the session (English when your input carries no language signal yet) instead of inferring a language from names, code, or tool output

title.zh-TW: 動手修改前核對更嚴謹並於受阻時先停下詢問
title.en: Stricter checks before editing and pausing to ask when blocked

body.zh-TW: 把專案交給代理查問題或修程式，最怕它太快下結論說找不到檔案，或自己繞過限制硬闖。⟦宛如老練的水電師傅進屋檢修，找不到管線先換幾個角落巡一遍、確認哪一戶報修、照原況重試一次再動扳手，碰到社區禁令或斷水閥門就停下來問屋主，絕不擅自繞道。⟧現在 Muse 動手前會把每一步核對得更仔細：宣告東西不存在前，會先試別種拼法與更寬的路徑；著手修復前，會先確認回報指向哪一份程式碼複本，並在原本出錯的環境設定下重跑具名的失敗測試。查案時也會讀取版本庫自己的歷史紀錄與上游分支。若變動受到版本庫規則禁止或管制，或是網路政策擋住某個步驟，它都會停下來詢問你，不再自己繞道處理。
body.en: When handing a project to an agent to investigate or fix, it is frustrating if it jumps too quickly to saying a file is missing or forces its way around limits. ⟦A seasoned plumber inspecting a house checks other corners before saying a pipe is missing, confirms which unit filed the report, and retries under the original conditions before touching a wrench, stopping to ask the homeowner rather than routing around a building rule or shutoff valve.⟧ Muse now verifies each step more carefully before acting: it tries other spellings and wider paths before saying something does not exist, confirms which copy of the code a report points to before fixing it, and reruns named failing tests in the setup where they failed. It also reads the repository's own history and upstream branch while investigating. If a change is forbidden or gated by a repository rule, or if a network policy blocks a step, it stops to ask you instead of routing around it.

items.original: Muse checks its work more carefully: it tries other spellings and wider paths before saying something does not exist, finds which copy of the code a report is about before fixing it, reruns named failing tests in the setup they failed in, asks before a change a repository rule forbids or gates, reads the repository's own history and upstream branch, and stops to ask when a network policy blocks a step instead of routing around it

title.zh-TW: 產出結果若落在別處直接補進指定位置
title.en: Results built elsewhere are added directly to the requested spot

body.zh-TW: 有時請代理產出內容，它卻把結果做在你最初指定以外的地方，還得你多點一次確認才肯搬過來。現在就算 Muse 把成果建在別的畫面、分頁、頁面或檔案裡，它也不會停下來問你要不要移過去，而是繼續完成並直接加進你當初要求的位置。當你在寫報告或整理筆記，指定要把段落補進某份檔案時，不用再多回一句「好，幫我放進去」就能直接看到結果到位。⟦猶如請人把整理好的資料放進指定抽屜，以前做完留在餐桌上還要問一聲要不要搬，現在會直接放進你說的抽屜才收工。⟧
body.en: Sometimes you ask an agent to produce something, and it builds the result somewhere other than where you first asked, leaving you to confirm one more time before moving it over. Now even if Muse builds a result in a different screen, tab, page, or file, it will not stop to ask whether to move it, and instead finishes the work and adds it directly where you asked. When you are writing a report or organizing notes and ask for a section to be added to a specific file, you see it land in place without having to reply "yes, put it in." ⟦Compare that to asking someone to put sorted papers into a specific drawer: before, they left them on the dining table and asked whether to move them, whereas now they place them straight into the drawer before wrapping up.⟧

items.original: Muse keeps working when it built a result somewhere other than the screen, tab, page, or file you named, and adds it where you asked instead of offering to

title.zh-TW: 長工作階段接近容量上限時改要簡短回覆
title.en: Long sessions request shorter replies when nearing capacity

body.zh-TW: 同一段對話聊久了、貼入的資料一多，最掃興的就是準備收尾時突然被一句超出容量擋在半路。⟦恰似裝行李快到登機箱極限時，工作人員不再直接拒收整箱物件，而是改請你挑最精簡的幾件塞進剩餘空間。⟧過去長工作階段只要輸入內容加上請求的輸出長度超過模型的脈絡視窗（模型單次能同時處理的文字容量），就會跳出錯誤並強制停下。現在當脈絡視窗快滿時，Muse 會主動請模型改給較簡短的回覆，讓工作階段繼續進行而不致中斷。
body.en: Nothing spoils the wrap-up of a long conversation packed with pasted material like suddenly hitting a capacity wall. ⟦When packing a carry-on approaches the size limit, staff no longer turn away the whole bag and instead ask you to pick only the most compact items for the remaining space.⟧ Previously, a long session stopped with an error whenever its input plus requested output exceeded the model's context window (how much text a model can handle at once). Now, when the context window is nearly full, Muse asks the model for a shorter reply so the session can keep going without stopping.

items.original: A long session no longer stops with an error that its input plus the requested output exceeds the model's context window: when the window is nearly full, Muse asks the model for a shorter reply instead

title.zh-TW: 含大量截圖的工作階段壓縮後最多保留約八張近期原圖
title.en: Compacted screenshot-heavy sessions keep up to about eight recent originals

body.zh-TW: 除錯或做設計時常在對話裡貼進一張張螢幕截圖，以前這類工作階段一旦執行壓縮，很容易直接跳過存檔，導致後面想接續對話無從接起。現在壓縮近期回合含大量完整尺寸圖片（例如截圖）的工作階段時，多數情況都能順利存下檢查點，讓你從該處繼續接續工作階段。壓縮後的脈絡會原封不動保留最近最多約八張完整尺寸的圖片；較早的圖片會改為摘要；若單批超過八張，該整批也會改為摘要。⟦如同整理旅行相簿，以前塞滿高畫質相片就整本卡住封存不了，現在可留下部分近期原片，把舊相片改寫成摘要；單批超過八張則整批摘要歸檔。⟧
body.en: Debugging or designing often fills a conversation with screenshots, and compacting those sessions used to skip saving a checkpoint, leaving you with nowhere to resume. Now when compacting a session whose recent turns hold many full-size images (such as screenshots), it saves its checkpoint in most cases so you can resume from that point. The compacted context keeps up to about eight recent full-size images as they are; older images are summarized, and if a single batch has more than eight, that entire batch is summarized too. ⟦Sorting a travel photo album used to stall the whole archive whenever it was packed with high-resolution shots, whereas now you can keep a portion of recent originals and turn older photos—or any single batch over eight—into summaries.⟧

items.original: Compacting a session whose recent turns hold many full-size images, such as screenshots, now saves its checkpoint in most cases instead of skipping it, so the session can resume from that point; the compacted context keeps up to about eight recent full-size images as they are; older images, and a single batch of more than eight, are summarized

title.zh-TW: 工作階段壓縮後分支或重開保留目標與背景復原
title.en: Compacted sessions keep goals and background recovery when forked or reopened

body.zh-TW:
工作階段經過壓縮後，無論是從中開出新分支還是重新打開接續，過去都容易在交接處出錯。⟦想像把長篇筆記精簡裝訂成精華冊，以前拆成新副本或重翻頁面時總會掉頁失聯，現在關鍵的索引與行程紀錄都穩穩留在冊子裡。⟧

在 `muse serve` 中針對已壓縮的工作階段分支對話（包括從它啟動的子代理），即使後續回合的指令只留在壓縮檢查點裡，現在也不再因為被判成格式錯誤的工作階段日誌而失敗。

設有目標的工作階段重新開啟後再進行分支時，就算該工作階段曾經在某個回合進行到一半時執行壓縮，現在也能順利分支而不報錯。

把工作階段壓縮並重新開啟之後，原本在背後運行的背景代理復原能力現在也能完整保留下來。
body.en:
After a session is compacted, both branching off a new conversation and reopening it to continue used to break at the handoff. ⟦Imagine binding long notes into a condensed booklet: splitting off a new copy or flipping back through pages used to drop sheets and lose track, whereas now key indexes and trip records stay intact inside.⟧

Forking a compacted session in `muse serve` (including any subagent started from it) no longer fails as a malformed session log even when later turns' instructions live only in the compaction checkpoint.

Forking a resumed session that has a goal now succeeds without error even if the session was compacted mid-turn.

Background agent recovery is now preserved after compacting and reopening a session.

items.original:
On a `muse serve` session that has compacted, forking the conversation, including a subagent that starts from it, no longer fails as a malformed session log when a later turn's instructions are kept only by the compaction checkpoint
Preserve background agent recovery after compacting and reopening a session
Forking a resumed session that has a goal no longer fails when the session compacted in the middle of a turn

title.zh-TW: 精簡長工作階段大量子代理的存檔與記憶體佔用
title.en: Trim saved state and memory use for long sessions with many subagents

body.zh-TW:
接手跑了很久、中途派過不少子代理分頭做事的對話時，以前重開畫面常覺得越跑越沉，甚至等半天才看到回覆。⟦彷彿爬山途中把已經吃完的乾糧包裝收進回收袋輕裝上路，過去空盒子全都繼續背在肩上越走越沉，現在只留沿途還用得上的補給。⟧

啟動大量子代理的長工作階段不會再突然停止儲存檢查點：只要某個子代理已經結束、主代理也已讀過它的結果（例如等待它完成），就算沒人手動關閉，只要對話不再提及它就會自動從存檔的工作階段中移除。

重開長工作階段時佔用的記憶體變少了，因為保留在記憶體裡的每筆工具任務紀錄體積都更小。

重開包含長串子代理歷史的工作階段後，畫面顯示回覆的延遲也獲得縮減。

重開帶有許多已完成子代理的工作階段時，首次讀取每個子代理會耗用更少記憶體並減少處理工時，因為已完成子代理的工具歷史不再被複製進追蹤子代理嘗試次數的紀錄簿裡。
body.en:
When picking up a long-running conversation that spawned many subagents to split the work, reopening the screen used to feel sluggish and take ages to show a reply. ⟦On a mountain hike, packing empty ration wrappers into a recycling bag lightens the load—instead of carrying every empty box on your shoulders and growing heavier, you keep only the supplies still needed along the trail.⟧

Long sessions that start many subagents no longer stop saving checkpoints: once a subagent finishes and the main agent has read its result (for example by waiting for it to finish), it automatically drops out of the saved session as soon as the conversation stops mentioning it, even if nobody closed it manually.

Resuming a long session uses less memory because each tool-task record kept in memory is smaller.

Reply display delays after resuming sessions with long subagent histories are also reduced.

Resuming a session with many finished subagents uses less memory and less work when first reading each of them, because a finished subagent's tool history is no longer copied into the bookkeeping that tracks subagent attempts.

items.original:
Long sessions that start many subagents no longer stop saving checkpoints: a subagent that finished and whose result the main agent already read, for example by waiting for it, now drops out of the saved session once the conversation no longer mentions it, even if nobody closed it
Resuming a long session uses less memory, because each tool-task record kept in memory is smaller
Reduce reply display delays after resuming sessions with long subagent histories
Resuming a session with many finished subagents uses less memory and does less work when it first reads each of them, because a finished subagent's tool history is no longer copied into the bookkeeping that tracks subagent attempts

title.zh-TW: 補齊工作流程取消拒絕原因與暫停重開狀態
title.en: Clarify Workflow Cancel Refusals and Preserve Pause and Resume State

body.zh-TW:
操作工作流程遇到取消被拒、暫停或重開接續時，以前往往摸不清失敗原因或弄丟額度設定。

當 `muse serve` 拒絕取消某個工作流程時，錯誤訊息裡新增的 `stopRefusal` 欄位會直接寫出確切的拒絕原因，例如 `stale_revision`。

如果取消工作流程的動作遇上工作階段儲存錯誤，`muse serve` 現在會附帶原因正式拒絕，不再直接回傳內部錯誤。

重新接續同一個 Workflow 時，使用者設定的 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）上限會原封不動保留下來。

暫停工作流程時，還沒跑完的背景工作不會再被誤報成遺失結果。過去在取消遇錯時只見內部錯誤、暫停時被報遺失結果，現在每種狀況都有清楚交代與保留。
body.en:
When a workflow cancel was refused, paused, or resumed, it was previously hard to tell why it failed or your limit settings would be lost.

When `muse serve` refuses to cancel a workflow, the new `stopRefusal` field in the error message now names the exact refusal reason, such as `stale_revision`.

If canceling a workflow hits a session storage error, `muse serve` now formally refuses it with a reason instead of returning an internal error.

When resuming the same Workflow, the user's limit on tokens (text units for AI processing and billing) is preserved intact.

When pausing a workflow, unfinished background work is no longer misreported as a missing result. Previously, cancel errors only showed an internal error and pauses reported missing results, whereas now every case is clearly explained and preserved.

items.original:
A workflow cancel that `muse serve` refuses now names the exact stop refusal in the error's new `stopRefusal` field, for example `stale_revision`
A workflow cancel that hits a session storage error is now refused with a reason by `muse serve` instead of failing with an internal error
Resuming the same Workflow preserves the user's token limit
Pausing a workflow no longer reports unfinished background work as a missing result

title.zh-TW: 修正忙碌時的訊息排隊、收回與中斷重送行為
title.en: Fix Message Queuing, Take-Back, and Interrupt Retries While Busy

body.zh-TW:
代理正在忙著處理任務時，你送出的新指令、插話或停止訊號以前常卡在交接空檔裡。⟦拿客滿時段的咖啡廳吧台來說，點單慢一點確認也不會把點單紙退回客人手裡，真要抽單而吧台塞滿時會等一下再請你重試，喊停時服務生也會再喊一聲確保停下。⟧

當代理忙碌時送出或排隊的訊息，若代理確認較慢，不會再跳出「steer failed」並退回輸入框，而是會維持在排隊狀態並順利送達一次。

用來中斷子代理的訊息，在替代的子代理啟動後，就會停止顯示為排隊中。

在 `muse serve` 裡，若某個卡住的工作階段指令佇列已滿，你想收回排隊中的訊息時，不會一直等到工作階段復原，改成在 30 秒後回傳可重試的忙碌錯誤。

按下停止（Stop）時，如果主機回報正在忙碌，Stop 會再次送出中斷訊號，讓執行中的回合真正停下來，不會繼續往下跑。
body.en:
When an agent was busy handling a task, new instructions, interruptions, or stop signals you sent often got stuck in handoff gaps. ⟦Consider a packed coffee counter: even if an order takes a moment to confirm, the ticket is not handed back to the customer, a cancellation at a jammed counter waits briefly before asking you to retry, and a call to stop is echoed again so work actually halts.⟧

A message sent or queued while the agent is busy no longer shows "steer failed" and returns to the input box if the agent is slow to confirm it; instead, it stays queued and is delivered once.

Messages used to interrupt a subagent stop showing as queued once the replacement subagent starts.

In `muse serve`, if a stuck session's command queue is full and you try to take back a queued message, it no longer waits until the session recovers and instead returns a retryable busy error after 30 seconds.

When you press Stop, if the host says it is busy, Stop sends the interrupt signal again so the running turn actually stops instead of continuing.

items.original:
In `muse serve`, taking back a queued message on a stuck session whose command queue is full now fails after 30 seconds with a busy error you can retry, instead of waiting until the session recovers
Messages that interrupt a subagent stop showing as queued when its replacement starts
Stop sends its interrupt again when the host says it is busy, so the running turn stops instead of running on
A message sent or queued while the agent is busy no longer shows "steer failed" and comes back to the input box when the agent is slow to confirm it; it stays queued and is delivered once

title.zh-TW: 工作階段協定為用戶端補齊狀態、錯誤與回執欄位
title.en: Session Protocol Adds Status, Error, and Receipt Fields for Clients

body.zh-TW:
開發自己的操作介面時，若想即時掌握背景執行進度或失敗原因，這套通訊規範（session protocol）現在提供更明確的訊號。

父工作階段在同伺服器開啟時，讀取子代理 `session/read` 會帶 `modelTurnRunning`，標明是否仍在跑模型回合。

`TurnErrorKind` 新增兩個不可重試類型：`reasoningReplayRefused` 為換模型後無法接續，`contextOverflow` 為超出脈絡視窗，既有比對會由預設分支接住。

開啟 Bash 標題時，殼層指令 `toolCall` 會帶安全顯示的短 `bashTitle`，免解析模型原文即可標記。

主體完成回執會以專屬歷史列送達，逾時、被插話轉向或被壓縮的工具主體都能保住結果與展開狀態。
body.en:
When building your own interface, the session protocol now gives clearer signals for tracking background progress or failure causes in real time.

When the parent session is open on the same server, reading a subagent via `session/read` now includes `modelTurnRunning` to indicate whether a model turn is still running.

`TurnErrorKind` adds two non-retryable types: `reasoningReplayRefused` for chats that cannot continue after a model switch, and `contextOverflow` for exceeding the context window; existing matches are caught by their default branch.

While Bash titles are enabled, a shell command `toolCall` carries a short, display-safe `bashTitle` so rows can be labeled without parsing the model's raw text.

Body-completion receipts arrive as dedicated history rows, preserving the results and expansion state of timed-out, steered, or compacted tool bodies.

items.original:
`session/read` of a subagent session now carries `modelTurnRunning`, which says whether the subagent is still running a model turn, when its parent session is open on the same server
`TurnErrorKind` gains `reasoningReplayRefused` (a chat that cannot continue after a model switch) and `contextOverflow` (a turn that cannot fit the model's context window), both not retryable, so session-protocol clients can tell these two failures apart; existing matches receive them in their catch-all arm
A session protocol `toolCall` item of a shell command now carries a short, display-safe title for the command (`bashTitle`) while Bash titles are on, so a client can label the row without parsing the model's raw text
Body-completion receipts now reach session-protocol clients as dedicated history rows, so a timed-out, steered, or compacted-away tool body keeps its result and expansion state on the client instead of dropping them

title.zh-TW: TypeScript SDK 支援傳入模擬主機函式進行測試
title.en: TypeScript SDK Supports Passing a Fake Host Function for Testing

body.zh-TW: 撰寫整合 TypeScript SDK 的工具時，如果測試流程一定得啟動真實的 `muse` 程序，在本機驗證時會綁手綁腳。⟦彷彿飛行員在地面用模擬駕駛艙練習起降流程，不必每次驗證儀表都把真飛機開上跑道。⟧現在 `MuseClient.spawn` 與 `spawnMspConnection` 都接受 `spawnFn` 選項，讓你能直接對記憶體內的模擬主機跑完交握與工作階段。當你準備測試用戶端與工具之間的連線流程時，只要透過 `spawnFn` 接入假主機，就能在記憶體中直接跑完整套工作階段互動，不必真的啟動 `muse` 程序。
body.en: When writing tools that integrate the TypeScript SDK, requiring a real `muse` process for every test makes local verification cumbersome. ⟦Pilots practice takeoffs and landings in a ground cockpit simulator rather than rolling a real aircraft onto the runway every time an instrument needs checking.⟧ Both `MuseClient.spawn` and `spawnMspConnection` now accept a `spawnFn` option, letting you run handshakes and sessions against an in-memory fake host. When you are ready to test the connection flow between a client and a tool, you can wire up a fake host through `spawnFn` and run the full session interaction in memory without starting a real `muse` process.

items.original: TypeScript SDK: `MuseClient.spawn` and `spawnMspConnection` accept a `spawnFn` option, so you can run the handshake and sessions against an in-memory fake host instead of a real `muse` process

title.zh-TW: 特定主機工作階段可依管理政策於啟動時調整沙盒與網路
title.en: Sessions on Specific Hosts Can Adjust Sandbox and Network at Start Under Policy

body.zh-TW: 如果用戶端需要讓工作階段在更寬鬆的環境下運行，這項權限現在能在連線之初提出申請。由 `muse serve --per-session` 或 `muse attach --stdio` 啟動的主機上，只要用戶端選擇啟用實驗性 API，工作階段就能在 `session/start` 時關閉沙盒（隔離執行的安全環境）或開啟網路，前提是不能超出管理政策允許的範圍。在團隊允許連網存取特定資源的情境下，用戶端便能在啟動階段直接完成這項調整。⟦試想進大樓實驗室申請開放外網與解除隔離區，就算手上拿著專案的實驗通行證，能開關的幅度依然受到管理規章限制。⟧
body.en: If a client needs a session to run in a less restricted environment, that permission can now be requested right at connection time. On a host started by `muse serve --per-session` or `muse attach --stdio`, as long as the client opts into the experimental API, a session can turn off its sandbox (an isolated, secure execution environment) or open its network at `session/start`, provided it stays within what managed policy allows. In scenarios where a team permits network access to specific resources, the client can complete this adjustment directly during startup. ⟦Entering a building lab to request external network access and lift isolation works the same way: even with an experimental project pass in hand, what you can toggle is still limited by management rules.⟧

items.original: A session on a host that `muse serve --per-session` or `muse attach --stdio` starts can turn its sandbox off or open its network at `session/start`, within what managed policy allows, when its client opts into the experimental API

title.zh-TW: muse serve 支援符號連結工作區以載入自訂代理
title.en: muse serve Supports Symlink Workspaces to Load Custom Agents

body.zh-TW: 不少人習慣把專案資料夾放在別顆硬碟，再用捷徑掛進工作目錄，以前在 `muse serve` 裡這條捷徑卻會直接把工作階段擋在門外。現在只要受信任的工作區路徑是指向資料夾的符號連結（symlink，指向另一個位置的捷徑檔），`muse serve` 啟動工作階段時就能正常載入該專案的自訂代理，不會再跳出「source root is a symlink」的失敗錯誤。⟦就像把門市入口設在轉角的連通道，過去警衛看到招牌後面是通道就拒收貨件，現在只要確認屬於信任範圍，照樣放行店內的專屬團隊進駐。⟧
body.en: Many people keep project folders on another drive and link them into their working directory with a shortcut, which previously caused `muse serve` to block the session at the door. Now, as long as a trusted workspace path is a symlink (a shortcut file pointing to another location) to a folder, `muse serve` starts the session and loads the project's custom agents normally instead of failing with "source root is a symlink". ⟦Placing a shop entrance in a corner passageway used to make the guard reject deliveries upon seeing a corridor behind the sign, but once confirmed as trusted, the store's dedicated team is now let right in.⟧

items.original: A `muse serve` session whose trusted workspace path is a symlink to a folder now starts with the project's custom agents instead of failing with "source root is a symlink"

title.zh-TW: 工作階段使用外掛期間重裝不再因權限差異失敗
title.en: Reinstalling a Plugin While in Use No Longer Fails on Permission Differences

body.zh-TW: 外掛正被某個工作階段使用中卻想重新安裝，過去常因為執行環境不同而直接碰壁。⟦恰似更換大樓電梯的保養零件，若只因早晚班技師設定的檢查權限略有不同，不會當場停用退件，而是先讓正在搭乘的這一趟安全運行，等乘客全數離開後下次保養再換新。⟧現在如果兩次安裝只是因為執行時的 umask（決定新檔案預設權限的環境遮罩）不同，例如一次從背景服務安裝、一次從終端機安裝，造成外掛頂層資料夾權限有差異，重裝時就不會再失敗。使用中的外掛複本會暫時保留不動，等那些工作階段都結束後，在下一次安裝時才會替換。
body.en: Trying to reinstall a plugin while a session was still using it often hit a wall because the execution environment differed. ⟦Replacing maintenance parts on a building elevator works the same way: if the only difference is slightly different inspection permissions set by morning and night technicians, the elevator is not halted on the spot, but allowed to finish its current trip safely and swapped out at the next service after all passengers exit.⟧ Now, if two installs differ only in the permissions of the plugin's top folder due to different runtime umasks (environment masks that set default permissions for new files)—such as one from a background service and one from a terminal—reinstalling no longer fails. The copy in use is left alone for now and replaced at the next install after those sessions end.

items.original: Reinstalling a plugin while a session is using it no longer fails when the only difference is the permissions of the plugin's top folder, which can differ when installs run under different umasks (for example one from a background service and one from a terminal); the copy in use is left alone and replaced at the next install after those sessions end

title.zh-TW: 當機或啟動中斷後可正常重開並列出取消呼叫
title.en: Reopen Normally After Startup Interruption or Crash and List Cancelled Calls

body.zh-TW: 萬一工作階段在啟動途中被中斷，或程式突然當機，重新接續時最怕既進不去也搞不清楚剛剛卡在哪。現在啟動期間遭到中斷的工作階段，重新開啟時會恢復正常進入，不再直接失敗。當機後重新接續工作階段時，畫面會顯示一則通知，列出當機當時被取消的呼叫；如果現場有印出異常結束通知，這份清單會併入其中，沒有異常結束通知時則會單獨以警告方式出現。⟦好比停電復電後重啟作業台，開機時不再因為上次沒啟動完就卡死，螢幕還會印出一張紙條列出斷電當下被迫取消的通話。⟧
body.en: If a session is interrupted during startup or the program suddenly crashes, the worst part of resuming is neither getting back in nor knowing where things stopped. Sessions interrupted during startup now reopen normally instead of failing. When resuming a session after a crash, a notice is shown listing the calls that the crash cancelled; if an abnormal-exit notice prints, this list is joined to it, and otherwise it appears on its own as a warning. ⟦Restarting a workstation after a power outage works much the same: it no longer freezes at boot just because the last startup was cut short, and the screen prints a slip listing the calls forced to cancel when the power went out.⟧

items.original:
Resuming a session after a crash now shows one notice listing the calls the crash cancelled, joined to the abnormal-exit notice when one prints, or on its own as a warning when it does not
Sessions interrupted during startup now reopen normally instead of failing

title.zh-TW: 回合存檔曾失敗時的日誌寫入降級提示不再遺失
title.en: Session Log Flush Degraded Note No Longer Goes Missing After Earlier Save Failures

body.zh-TW: 執行回合的半途若曾發生存檔失敗，結尾原本該顯示的警告提示過去在幾種情況下會悄悄不見。現在回合結束時的「session log flush degraded」提示不會再遺失。無論是回合稍早存檔失敗後中途由檢查點把工作階段日誌寫出，或是存檔失敗後該回合接著送出影片、結算了一筆跨重啟等待的工具核准，這則警示都會在回合結束時照常留下。⟦跟帳房在每日結算對帳一樣，只要當天曾有過寫帳失敗，不管中途有無補登或後來又附了影像與隔夜簽呈，結帳時依舊會把警示便條留在頁尾。⟧
body.en: If a save failed mid-turn, the warning note that was supposed to appear at the end previously vanished in several scenarios. Now, the "session log flush degraded" note at the end of a turn no longer goes missing. Whether a checkpoint flushed the session log mid-turn after an earlier save failure, or the turn sent a video or settled a tool approval that waited across a restart after a save failed, the warning still stays at the end of the turn. ⟦Bookkeepers reconciling daily accounts do the same thing: as long as a ledger write failed earlier that day, regardless of mid-day catch-up entries or later videos and overnight sign-offs, the warning slip still remains at the bottom of the page at closing.⟧

items.original:
The "session log flush degraded" note at the end of a turn no longer goes missing when a checkpoint flushed the session log after a save had failed earlier in the turn
The "session log flush degraded" note at the end of a turn no longer goes missing when a save failed earlier in the turn and the turn then sent a video or settled a tool approval that waited across a restart

title.zh-TW: 非 UTF-8 路徑下的工作階段索引不再卡死關機
title.en: Session Index Under Non-UTF-8 Paths No Longer Hangs Shutdown

body.zh-TW: 把工作階段資料夾放在含有非 UTF-8 字元的路徑底下時，以前一關掉程式就容易陷入停不下來的僵局。⟦猶如車用導航遇到認不得的亂碼路名時，不斷在原地重新計算路線而遲遲無法熄火停車，現在碰到這種奇怪路徑不再無止境重算。⟧當 `sessions` 資料夾位於不是有效 UTF-8（一種常見的電腦文字編碼標準）的路徑底下時，工作階段索引過去會反覆不斷地重寫自己，連帶讓整個程式卡在關機步驟。這項錯誤已經修好，現在工作階段索引不會再無止境重寫並卡死關機流程。
body.en: When placing the sessions folder under a path with non-UTF-8 characters, shutting down the program previously got stuck in an endless loop. ⟦Car navigation systems hitting an unreadable garbled street name behave similarly, endlessly recalculating the route in place and refusing to power down, whereas now such odd paths no longer trigger endless recalculation.⟧ When the `sessions` folder is under a path that is not valid UTF-8 (a common computer text-encoding standard), the session index previously kept rewriting itself forever and hung the shutdown step. That bug is fixed, and the session index no longer rewrites itself endlessly or hangs shutdown.

items.original: Session index no longer rewrites itself forever and hangs shutdown when the sessions folder is under a path that is not valid UTF-8

title.zh-TW: 終端機程式狀態在背景回合完成後正確回到閒置
title.en: Terminal Program Status Returns to Idle After Background Turns Complete

body.zh-TW: 自家回合曾執行失敗後，就算後續的背景排程已經順利跑完，終端機的狀態燈號以前還是會卡在舊錯誤上。在支援顯示程式狀態（OSC 7501，終端機用來接收程式狀態訊號的控制規格）的終端機裡，現在當你原本的回合失敗、之後有排程或其他背景回合完成時，狀態會正常回到閒置，不會在每次背景回合結束後又把那個舊錯誤重秀一遍。⟦若把終端機狀態燈比作洗衣機面板上的提示燈，以前上一次脫水故障亮過紅燈後，之後每次背景自動烘衣結束都會再亮一次舊故障燈，現在背景程序完成便會乖乖切回待機狀態。⟧
body.en: After one of your own turns failed, a terminal's status indicator previously stayed stuck on the old error even when subsequent background schedules finished cleanly. In terminals that support showing program status (OSC 7501, a control specification for receiving status signals), the status now returns to idle when a scheduled or other background turn completes after your original turn failed, rather than displaying that old error again after every background turn. ⟦A washing machine's panel light works the same way: after a spin-cycle fault turned it red once, every later automatic drying cycle in the background used to flash that same old fault light again, whereas now it switches back to standby once the background cycle finishes.⟧

items.original: Terminals that show program status (OSC 7501) now return to idle when a scheduled or other background turn completes after one of your turns failed, instead of showing that old error again after every background turn

title.zh-TW: 執行 /goal resume 可直接顯示答案不必重開對話
title.en: Running /goal resume Shows Answers Directly Without Reopening the Conversation

body.zh-TW: 用目標功能整理專案重點、等著看指令的答案時，若還得重新打開原本的對話才能看到結果，手上的工作就多了一道操作。使用 `/goal resume` 後，現在能直接看到該指令的答案，不必重新開啟對話。⟦好比在服務櫃檯等答覆，以前得重新推門進接待室才能聽到回答，現在站在櫃檯就能直接聽見；不必為了得到這句答覆，再把剛才離開的房門打開一次。⟧
body.en: When you use the goals feature to organize project highlights and are waiting for a command's answer, having to reopen the original conversation just to view the result adds an extra step to your workflow. After running `/goal resume`, you can now see that command's answer directly without reopening the conversation. ⟦Waiting at a service counter for a reply illustrates this well: previously you had to push open the door back into the reception room to hear the response, whereas now you can hear it right at the counter without opening the door you just walked out of again just to get that answer.⟧

items.original: Show answers from `/goal resume` without reopening the conversation

title.zh-TW: 訊息核准預覽完整保留比較運算子與底線
title.en: Message Approval Previews Preserve Comparison Operators and `_` Characters

body.zh-TW: 準備核准代理送出的訊息前，螢幕上的預覽畫面是你確認文字有沒有出錯的唯一依據。如果待送出的內容裡包含比較運算子（例如用來判斷大小的 `<` 或 `>` 符號）或是像 `user_name` 這樣帶有底線的字詞，現在的訊息核准預覽都會原樣保留這些符號與底線。⟦假想印刷廠送印前給你一張校對樣張，過去某些大於小於記號和底線常在樣張上漏印，現在每個符號都安安穩穩印在紙面上供你逐字確認。⟧
body.en: Before approving a message for the agent to send, the preview on your screen is your only basis for checking whether any text went wrong. If the outgoing content contains comparison operators (such as `<` or `>` symbols for checking size) or terms with `_` characters like `user_name`, message approval previews now preserve those symbols and `_` characters intact. ⟦Print-shop proof sheets work the same way: before a press run, you rely on a proof sheet where greater-than, less-than, and `_` marks used to go missing, and now every mark stays printed on the page for you to verify character by character.⟧

items.original: Message approval previews preserve comparison operators and underscores

title.zh-TW: 報表與年度帳本的歷史紀錄更準確
title.en: More accurate history in reports and the year ledger

body.zh-TW:
翻開歷史報表核對用量，現在不用擔心數字卡在舊紀錄或被覆蓋。

Antigravity 計數修正前存下的舊日子，token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）總數偏高，過去因為快照只在新數字不小於舊紀錄時才替換而換不進去。現在快照會記下計數版次，只要當天所有工作階段與其他工具紀錄還在本機，就換成修正數字。年度帳本等快照換好才更新，報表也不再補回舊差額。

報表與背景更新在不同行程同時寫入 `year_ledger.json` 時，過去會互相蓋掉剛存下或補回的日子。現在帳本旁會建鎖檔，一次只讓一個行程讀取、合併並寫回。別的行程佔鎖超過 10 秒就跳過等下次補，沒拿到鎖不寫入。

「全部」報表過去從有 token 用量的第一天起算，漏掉更早只有活躍紀錄的日子。現在改從最早有用量或活躍紀錄那天開始，日期篩選器也選得到。
body.en:
When checking past usage in historical reports, you no longer have to worry about numbers getting stuck on old records or overwritten.

Old Antigravity days saved before the counting fix had inflated token (text units AI processes and bills by) totals, which could not be replaced before because the snapshot only swapped in a new number when it was at least as large as the old one. Now the snapshot records the counting version and swaps in the corrected number as long as all sessions and other tool records from that day are still on disk. The year ledger waits until the snapshot finishes replacing the day before updating, and reports no longer add back the old difference.

When a report and a background update ran in separate processes and wrote to `year_ledger.json` at the same time, they could overwrite days the other had just saved or backfilled. Now a lock file is created next to the ledger so only one process at a time can read, merge, and write it back. If another process holds the lock for more than 10 seconds, this update is skipped for later, and nothing is written without the lock.

The "All-time" report used to start from the first day with token usage, leaving out earlier days that only had activity records. It now starts from the earliest day with either usage or activity records, and the date picker can select that day too.

items.original:
**Antigravity days in the snapshot now show the corrected token totals.** Before this fix, the daily snapshot replaced a saved day only if the new total was at least as large. Antigravity days saved before the token-counting fix were too high, so the smaller corrected totals never replaced them, in reports or in the snapshot file. The snapshot now records which counting version produced each day. It replaces an old Antigravity day only when every session and every other tool's records from that day are still on disk. The year ledger updates that day only after the snapshot has replaced it, and reports no longer add the old difference back from the ledger.
**Generating a report no longer erases days that background updates just saved to the year ledger.** The year ledger was protected only by a lock inside a single process. When the report ran in a separate process, the report and the background updates could write the ledger at the same time, and one write could erase days the other had just saved or backfilled. usage now creates a lock file next to `year_ledger.json`, so only one process at a time can read, merge, and write the ledger. If another process holds the lock for more than 10 seconds, usage skips this update and tries again later. It never writes without the lock.
**All-time reports include earlier Claude Code activity.** The report used to start on the first day with token usage, so it left out earlier days that had activity but no token records. It now starts on the earliest day with either, and the date picker can select that day.

title.zh-TW: 專案分類與報表匯出檔名更清楚
title.en: Clearer project labels and report export file names

body.zh-TW:
匯出專案排行或翻找幾個月前的報表檔案，標籤和檔名常讓人一頭霧水。

匯出專案 CSV 過去先取前 10 名才挑出只剩總數的舊紀錄，第 10 名專案會被擠掉。現在比照報表畫面先挑出舊紀錄，列在最後一列，再取前 10 名專案。

Codex 找不到工作階段的工作資料夾時，會把專案記成 `unknown`，過去報表一律當成舊紀錄。現在報表和網頁篩選器會檢查資料是否來自舊帳本，是才標成「舊紀錄（只剩總數）」，其餘無名稱的用量顯示「未知」。

HTML、CSV 和 PNG 匯出檔過去用匯出當天命名，隔幾個月重開看不出資料期間。現在改用涵蓋日期命名，像 `usage-report-2026-10-01_2026-11-17.csv`，無日期篩選器的報表仍用匯出日。匯出的 HTML 重開時也會停在同一段日期。
body.en:
Exporting project rankings or digging up report files from months ago used to leave you guessing at labels and file names.

Project CSV exports used to take the top 10 rows before setting aside old total-only records, which pushed out the 10th project. Now, matching the report view, old records are set aside first and placed in the last row before taking the top 10 projects.

When Codex cannot find a session's working directory, it records the project as `unknown`, which reports used to treat as old records across the board. Now the report and web filter check whether the data came from the old ledger: only those rows are labeled "Old records (totals only)", while other unnamed usage shows as "unknown".

HTML, CSV, and PNG exports used to be named after the export date, making it hard to tell which period they covered when reopened months later. They are now named after the covered dates, such as `usage-report-2026-10-01_2026-11-17.csv`, while reports without a date picker still use the export date. Reopening an exported HTML file also stays on those same dates.

items.original:
**CSV exports no longer drop the 10th project when old total-only records exist.** The project CSV export took the top 10 rows first and set aside old total-only records second. Those records took one of the 10 places, so the 10th project was left out. The export now sets aside old total-only records first and then takes the top 10 projects, the same way the report chart does. The old records get their own row at the end.
**Usage with no project name shows as "unknown", not "Old records (totals only)".** When Codex can't find a session's working directory, it records the project as `unknown`. The report treated every `unknown` project as old total-only history. The report and its filter now check whether a row came from the old total-only ledger. Only those rows are labeled "Old records (totals only)"; current usage with no project shows as "unknown".
**Report exports are named after the dates they cover.** HTML, CSV, and PNG exports used to be named after the day you exported them. If you opened a filtered export months later, you couldn't tell from the file name which period it covered. Files are now named like `usage-report-2026-10-01_2026-11-17.csv`. Reports without a date picker still use the export date. An exported HTML report reopens at the same dates.

title.zh-TW: 額度讀數時效與提醒不再誤報
title.en: Accurate quota reading ages and no more false alerts

body.zh-TW:
看終端機底下的狀態列與額度提示，讀數新舊和警告現在不再亂跳。

Muse 過重置時間若沒重讀，過去把 0% 當真在 macOS 與 Windows 跳「已恢復」通知，現在改等新讀數。

Muse 卡片與狀態列改用伺服器查額度時間判斷過期與年齡，重讀舊額度不再像剛查的。

重置估計提前超過 10 分鐘時（如切換額度來源），只要用量停在已警告程度，額度感知模式就不重複警告。

Claude Code 替各時段分開記讀取時間，五小時額度不再顯示週額度舊時間。狀態列 hook（特定事件發生時觸發的小程式）升到 1.21，額度感知為 1.19。

Codex 替各額度保留最新拒絕只套用到對應時段，Codex Spark 較晚被拒時，不再藏起一般額度拒絕。
body.en:
Checking the status line at the bottom of your terminal and quota prompts, reading ages and warnings no longer jump around.

When Muse passed its reset time without a fresh reading, it used to treat 0% as real and trigger a "restored" notification on macOS and Windows; it now waits for a new reading.

The Muse card and status line now use the server's quota check time to judge staleness and age, so re-reading an old quota no longer looks freshly checked.

When the reset estimate moves earlier by more than 10 minutes (such as when switching quota sources), quota-aware mode no longer repeats the warning as long as usage stays at an already-warned level.

Claude Code now records a separate reading time for each window, so the five-hour quota no longer shows the weekly quota's old timestamp. The status line hook (a small program triggered by specific events) updates to 1.21, and quota-aware updates to 1.19.

Codex now keeps the latest rejection for each quota and applies it only to the matching window, so a newer Codex Spark rejection no longer hides a general quota rejection.

items.original:
**usage no longer sends a Muse "restored" notification just because the reset time passed.** For Claude Code, Codex, and Antigravity, usage sends nothing when the reset time passes; it waits for a new reading. For Muse, it treated the 0% shown after the reset as a real reading. So when Muse sat idle and was not checked again, usage sent a "restored" notification on macOS and Windows. usage now handles Muse the same way as the other tools.
**Quota-aware mode no longer repeats a warning when the reset estimate moves earlier.** If the estimated reset time moved more than ten minutes earlier, usage treated it as a new window and sent the same warning again. This happened, for example, when Antigravity switched between its two quota sources. Now, as long as your usage stays at the level you were already warned about, you won't get the warning again, whichever way the estimate moves.
**Muse readings use the time Muse's server checked the quota.** When usage read an old allowance again, the reading could look new. The Muse card and the status line now use the server's check time to decide on the stale notice and to show the reading's age.
**Quota-aware mode shows how old a reused Claude Code reading is.** When the status line redrew, an old reading could look current. usage now records a separate reading time for each quota window, so a fresh five-hour reading no longer shows the weekly reading's age. The status line hook updates to 1.21 and the quota-aware hook to 1.19.
**A Codex quota rejection now applies only to its own quota.** When a dedicated quota such as Codex Spark was rejected more recently than the general Codex quota, usage hid the general rejection and showed the general window below 100%. usage now keeps the latest rejection for each quota and applies it only to the matching window.

title.zh-TW: 只裝 Grok CLI 開啟狀態列不再報錯
title.en: No error when enabling the status line with only Grok CLI installed

body.zh-TW: 電腦裡只裝了 Grok CLI，開關狀態列卻一直跳出失敗訊息？Grok 狀態列當時已經裝好了，只是 usage 找不到 Claude Code 或 Codex 就跟著回報錯誤。現在只要 Grok 狀態列設定完成，就會回報成功。
body.en: Have only the Grok CLI installed and keep getting a failure message when toggling the status line? The Grok status line was actually already installed, but usage reported an error because it could not find Claude Code or Codex. Now it reports success once the Grok status line is set up.

items.original: **Turning on the status line with only the Grok CLI installed no longer reports a failure.** usage installed the Grok status line, but the switch still showed an error because it found neither Claude Code nor Codex. It now reports success once the Grok status line is set up.

title.zh-TW: 修復續談 hook 會保留較新的腳本
title.en: Repairing the resume hook keeps newer scripts

body.zh-TW: 續談用的提示檔不見了，想跑修復卻怕蓋掉後來裝好的新版程式。現在修復續談 hook 時，usage 只會把遺失的提示檔補回來，已安裝的較新腳本會原封不動留在原地。
body.en: If your resume prompt file went missing, you might hesitate to run a repair for fear of overwriting a newer script installed later. Now when repairing the resume hook, usage only restores the missing prompt file and leaves any newer installed script untouched.

items.original: **Repairing the resume hook keeps newer scripts.** When the prompt file goes missing, usage restores it and leaves a newer installed script in place.

title.zh-TW: 新的 Codex 模型只會公告一次
title.en: New Codex models are announced only once

body.zh-TW: 同一個對話裡，某個模型先出現在用量紀錄、後來又進到 Codex 模型清單，過去 usage 總共發出兩次通知。現在 usage 會沿用第一次的紀錄並保留首次出現的時間，不再重複公告。
body.en: Within the same conversation, if a model appeared in usage logs first and later showed up in the Codex model list, usage used to send two notifications. Now usage reuses the first record and keeps its first-seen time instead of announcing it again.

items.original: **New Codex models are announced only once.** If a model showed up in usage logs first, usage announced it, then announced it again in the same conversation when the model later appeared in the Codex model list. usage now reuses the first record and keeps its first-seen time.

title.zh-TW: GPT-6.2 Sol 與 Astra 離線也有價
title.en: GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra have offline pricing

body.zh-TW: 無法下載價目表時，Codex 新的 GPT-6.2 模型花費過去會被算成 $0。現在內建的備援價目表已經收錄它們的單價，斷線也能照常計費：Sol 每百萬 token 輸入 $2、輸出 $10，Astra 則是輸入 $8、輸出 $40。
body.en: When the price table could not be downloaded, Codex's new GPT-6.2 models used to be counted at $0. The built-in fallback price table now includes their rates so billing still works offline: Sol is $2 input and $10 output per million tokens, while Astra is $8 input and $40 output.

items.original: **GPT-6.2 Sol and GPT-6.2 Astra have prices when offline.** When the price table could not be downloaded, usage counted Codex's new GPT-6.2 models at $0. The built-in fallback price table now includes them: Sol $2 / $10 and Astra $8 / $40 per million input / output tokens.

title.zh-TW: 精簡模式不限制創作且誠實交代驗證
title.en: Token Saver unblocks creative writing and reports verification honestly

body.zh-TW:
開啟精簡模式省字數，過去常連帶綁住創作內容或讓回覆過度簡略。

「不用比喻、表情符號、裝飾性表格」這幾條規定現在只管 Claude 自己的回覆。你請它寫的文章、貼文或簡報不用遵守，要它寫一篇滿是比喻的貼文也不會再跟精簡模式衝突。

改檔或跑指令後，短回覆不能再把沒驗證的事說成做完了。Claude 現在會交代驗證了什麼，沒測過或只做一部分會直說，也會把沒驗證的假設與還沒解決的風險寫完整。如果你的 `CLAUDE.md` 有教學規則、你要求用比喻或說看不懂，這些都優先於精簡；「不要自創縮寫」也拿掉了「縮寫省不到 token」這句沒有證據的說法。

⟦就像請秘書平時用條列快報進度，他自己的工作匯報會力求精短、沒確認完的事也老實標出來，但替你代筆的活動致詞稿仍會保留比喻和圖表。⟧
body.en:
Turning on Token Saver to save words used to restrict creative writing as well or make replies overly terse.

The rules against analogies, emoji, and decorative tables now apply only to Claude's own replies. Articles, posts, or slides you ask it to write do not have to follow them, so asking for a post full of analogies will no longer conflict with Token Saver.

After editing files or running commands, short replies can no longer claim unverified work is done. Claude now states what it verified, says plainly when something is untested or only partly done, and writes out unverified assumptions and open risks in full. If your `CLAUDE.md` has teaching rules, or if you ask for analogies or say you do not follow, those take priority over brevity; the rule against made-up abbreviations also drops the unsupported claim that abbreviations save no tokens.

⟦Think of a secretary who normally gives you bullet-point progress updates: his own work reports stay brief and flag anything unverified, while the event speeches he drafts for you still keep their analogies and charts.⟧

items.original:
**Token Saver's rules against analogies, emoji, and decorative tables now apply only to Claude's own replies.** Articles, posts, and slides you ask Claude to write no longer have to follow them. If you ask for a post full of analogies, you no longer run into a conflict with Token Saver.
**Token Saver no longer allows a short reply to call unverified work done.** After Claude edits files or runs commands, its reply now says what it verified, and says plainly when work is untested or only partly done. Claude writes out unverified assumptions and open risks in full. Teaching rules in your CLAUDE.md, a request for an analogy, or saying you don't follow now take priority over keeping replies short. The rule against made-up abbreviations also no longer says that abbreviations save no tokens, because there was no evidence for that.

title.zh-TW: Windows 系統匣提示不列隱藏工具
title.en: Windows tray tooltip drops hidden tools

body.zh-TW: 滑鼠移到 Windows 系統匣圖示上，想看各工具額度卻發現排在後面的不見了。過去即使你在「隱藏區塊」藏起 Claude 和 Codex，提示文字仍會硬塞這兩行，把後面的工具擠出 Windows 的 127 字元上限。現在被隱藏的工具不會再出現。唯一保留的是選為「系統匣顯示來源」的工具，因為圖示上顯示的正是它的數字。
body.en: Hovering over the Windows tray icon to check each tool's quota used to cut off the tools at the end. Even when you hid Claude and Codex under Hide Sections, the tooltip still crammed in their lines and pushed the last tools past Windows' 127-character limit. Hidden tools are now left out. The only one kept is the tool chosen as Tray Display Source, because the icon shows its number.

items.original: **The Windows tray tooltip no longer lists a tool you hid under Hide Sections.** Claude and Codex were always listed, even when hidden, and their lines could push the last tools past Windows' 127-character tooltip limit. A hidden tool's line is now left out; the tool chosen as Tray Display Source stays, because the icon shows its number.

title.zh-TW: macOS 深色選單列圖示恢復可見
title.en: macOS dark menu bar icons are visible again

body.zh-TW: 把 macOS Tahoe 螢幕最上方調成暗色外觀後，原本掛在那裡的幾個工具小標誌是不是直接隱形了？之前 Claude、Codex、Antigravity、Grok 與 Muse 的圖示一律畫成黑色，換成深色背景就整個融進去。現在圖示會跟著選單列的文字顏色走，淺色或深色都能看清楚。
body.en: After switching the top bar on macOS Tahoe to a dark appearance, did the small tool icons sitting there seem to vanish? Previously, the Claude, Codex, Antigravity, Grok, and Muse icons were always drawn in black, so they blended right into a dark background. They now follow the menu bar's text color, staying clear in both light and dark modes.

items.original: **Menu bar icons are visible again on a dark menu bar.** The Claude, Codex, Antigravity, Grok, and Muse icons were drawn black even when the menu bar was dark, so on macOS Tahoe they disappeared against it. They now follow the menu bar's text color in light and dark. Reported in #352.

title.zh-TW: 5 小時額度與通知不被舊讀數拖累
title.en: 5-hour quotas and alerts stay unaffected by old readings

body.zh-TW:
5 小時窗口照理說各自獨立計算，之前只要遇上過期或重置的舊數字，卡片和通知卻常跟著亂套。

Antigravity 週額度更新失敗、只能沿用舊讀數時，過去整張卡會被標成過期，5 小時的燃燒率、通知與窗口保持功能全都停住。現在只有週額度那一列顯示資料放了多久，5 小時那一列照常運作。

額度通知也不再拿重置前的讀數來判斷。過了重置時間後，舊百分比以前還可能發出「已用完」通知，或把下一個窗口的通知擋掉。現在 macOS 與 Windows 上，過了重置時間的窗口都會安靜結束。⟦月票過期本來不該影響買單程票進站，以前舊數字一過期卻把單程閘門也鎖住，現在各算各的互不干擾。⟧
body.en:
Each 5-hour window is supposed to be calculated on its own, yet stale or pre-reset numbers used to throw off both the card and notifications.

When Antigravity failed to refresh its weekly quota and had to carry over an old reading, the entire card was marked stale, stopping the 5-hour burn rate, notifications, and the window keeper. Now only the weekly row shows how old the data is, while the 5-hour row keeps working.

Quota notifications also stop using readings from before a window reset. Past the reset time, an old percentage could still trigger a "used up" alert or block notifications for the next window. On both macOS and Windows, any window past its reset time now ends quietly. ⟦An expired monthly pass should not stop you from buying a single-ride ticket, yet an expired old number used to lock the single-ride gate as well—now each runs on its own without getting in the way.⟧

items.original:
**The Antigravity card no longer goes stale when only its weekly reading is carried over.** When the weekly reading could not be refreshed, the whole card was marked stale, which stopped the 5-hour burn rate, notifications, and the window keeper. Now only the weekly row shows its age, and the 5-hour row keeps working.
**Quota notifications no longer use a reading from before the window reset.** After the reset time passed, the old percentage could still send a "used up" notification or block the next window's notifications. On macOS and Windows, a window past its reset time now ends quietly.

title.zh-TW: 報表未定價與舊紀錄不再誤標 $0
title.en: Unpriced and old report entries no longer show $0

body.zh-TW:
打開報表看到好幾個專案寫著 $0.00，還有一筆「unknown」排在榜首，很容易誤以為沒花到錢或這項目最燒額度。

只用到未定價模型的專案，現在一律改顯示橫線而不是 $0.00，套用日期篩選後也一樣。

模型 ID 整理前留下的舊 Antigravity 歷史，曾保有像 `gemini-3.8-flash-n` 這類原始 ID。這讓同個模型在報表被列兩次，數十億個 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）也被算成 $0。現在這批紀錄會併回整理後的名稱並計價。

2026 年 8 月以前只存下每日總量的用量沒有專案和工具資料，以前被當成「unknown」以 $0.00 排第一。現在它改成排在最底下灰色的「舊紀錄（只剩總數）」，金額顯示未知，趨勢圖圖例也用同一個名稱，百分比不變。
body.en:
Opening the report to find several projects listed at $0.00 and an "unknown" entry at the top makes it easy to think nothing was spent or that it burned the most quota.

Projects that use only unpriced models now show "—" instead of $0.00, including after date filtering.

Older Antigravity history saved before model IDs were cleaned up kept raw IDs such as `gemini-3.8-flash-n`. That caused the same model to appear twice in the report and left billions of tokens (the text units AI processes and bills for) priced at $0. Those records are now merged into the clean name and priced.

Usage saved only as daily totals before August 2026 has no project or tool data, and it used to rank first as "unknown" at $0.00. It now appears at the bottom as a grey "Old records (totals only)" row with an unknown cost, and the trend legend uses the same name while percentages stay unchanged.

items.original:
**Projects that use only unpriced models show "—" instead of $0.00 in the report,** including after date filtering.
**Older Antigravity history no longer lists one model twice or leaves it unpriced in the report.** History saved before model IDs were cleaned up kept raw IDs such as `gemini-3.8-flash-n`, which left billions of tokens priced at $0. They are now merged with the clean name and priced.
**Usage saved only as daily totals no longer ranks as your top project or tool.** Usage from before August 2026 has no project or tool, and the report listed it as the top "unknown" project and tool at $0.00. It now shows as a grey "Old records (totals only)" row at the bottom with an unknown cost, and the trend legend uses the same name. Percentages are unchanged.

title.zh-TW: 狀態列開關與跨帳號用量不再錯亂
title.en: Status line switch and cross-account usage stop mixing up

body.zh-TW:
在 Windows 點了狀態列沒反應，或是換完帳號發現額度百分比還停在舊帳號那邊。

在 Windows 系統匣切換狀態列或安裝 hook（特定事件發生時觸發的小程式）失敗時，現在會直接跳出錯誤提示，不再悄悄沒反應。

換到沒有 5 小時額度的帳號後，狀態列與額度感知模式不再沿用前一個帳號的 5 小時用量。以前這兩個功能會拿舊帳號數字補缺口，讓原本沒有 5 小時額度的帳號顯示成 99% 已用。現在只會用同一個帳號的資料補窗口，狀態列 hook 已更新為 1.19，額度感知 hook 更新為 1.17。

當你讓 Claude Code 用自己的狀態列、只留 Grok 用 usage 的狀態列時，開關現在會正確顯示為開啟。原本它會顯示關閉，按下去反而重新安裝狀態列，而不是關掉 Grok 那邊。
body.en:
Clicking the status line in Windows could do nothing, or switching accounts could leave your quota percentage stuck on the old account.

When toggling the status line or installing a hook (a small program triggered by specific events) fails in the Windows tray, it now shows an error instead of failing silently.

After switching to an account without a 5-hour limit, the status line and quota-aware mode no longer carry over the previous account's 5-hour usage. They used to fill the missing window with numbers from the old account, making an account with no 5-hour limit show 99% used. A missing window is now filled only from the same account, with the status-line hook updated to 1.19 and the quota-aware hook to 1.17.

When Claude Code uses its own status line and only Grok uses usage's status line, the switch now correctly shows as on. It previously showed as off, and clicking it reinstalled the status line instead of turning Grok's off.

items.original:
**The Windows tray now reports a failed status line toggle or hook install** instead of failing silently.
**Switching to an account without a 5-hour limit no longer keeps the previous account's 5-hour usage.** The status line and quota-aware mode filled the missing window from the old account, so they could show 99% used on an account that has no 5-hour limit. A missing window is now filled only from the same account. The status-line hook updates to 1.19 and the quota-aware hook to 1.17.
**The status line switch shows as on when only Grok uses it beside your own Claude Code status line.** It showed as off, and turning it on installed the status line again instead of turning Grok's off.

title.zh-TW: 新舊模型分組與 Mythos 離線定價對齊
title.en: Model groups and Mythos offline pricing aligned

body.zh-TW:
各家模型改名、退場或出新版時，清單跟價目表沒跟著動就容易對不上用量。

Antigravity 將於 2026-11-18 下架 GPT-OSS，它已從 Claude 與 GPT 模型群組拿掉。名稱帶有連字號的 Antigravity 群組模型，現在也對得上你的用量紀錄。

Gemini 4 Carbon 在介面上的顯示名稱調整為「Carbon 4」。

使用 Gemini 4 Argon 與 Orchestrator (Argon) 期間，Antigravity 狀態列會顯示 Argon 額度。原本它只會顯示 Claude 與 GPT 群組或 Gemini 群組。

價目表這邊也補上了 Claude Mythos 5 與 Mythos 5.2 的離線價格，價目表檢查同步涵蓋 Mythos 模型。
body.en:
When models are renamed, retired, or newly released, usage stops matching up if the lists and price table fall behind.

GPT-OSS, which Antigravity retires on 2026-11-18, has been removed from the Claude and GPT model group. Antigravity group models with hyphenated names now also match your usage logs.

Gemini 4 Carbon now displays in the interface as "Carbon 4".

While using Gemini 4 Argon and Orchestrator (Argon), the Antigravity status line shows the Argon quota. Previously, it only showed the Claude and GPT group or the Gemini group.

Offline prices for Claude Mythos 5 and Mythos 5.2 have been added to the price table, and the price-table check now covers Mythos models as well.

items.original:
**GPT-OSS, which Antigravity retires on 2026-11-18, was removed from the Claude and GPT model group,** and Antigravity group models with hyphenated names now match your usage logs.
**Gemini 4 Carbon now shows as "Carbon 4".**
**Offline prices for Claude Mythos 5 and Mythos 5.2 were added,** and the price-table check now covers Mythos models.
**The Antigravity status line shows the Argon quota for Gemini 4 Argon and Orchestrator (Argon).** It showed the Claude and GPT group or the Gemini group instead.

title.zh-TW: 新模型偵測不再重複或漏掉提醒
title.en: New model detection stops repeating or missing alerts

body.zh-TW:
有時才剛看過新模型登場提示，轉頭用 Codex 又再跳一次；換成 Antigravity 推出新模型卻安安靜靜沒通知。

在額度感知模式下，Codex 模型目錄已經記錄過的模型，第一次實際用到時不再從用量紀錄重複提醒一次。

如果第一次掃描 Antigravity 時裡面的模型都已從其他工具認得，usage 現在會記下已經掃描過。往後有新模型出現就不會被當成第一次掃描的一部分，照樣會發出提醒。⟦點名冊就像店裡的熟客名單，以前看過的名單還會重複唱名、沒登記到的新分店又漏掉新客人，現在都只為真正第一次上門的新面孔報到。⟧
body.en:
Sometimes a new-model alert popped up again right after you used Codex, while an actual new Antigravity model triggered no notification at all.

In quota-aware mode, a model already recorded in the Codex catalog is no longer announced a second time from usage logs when you first use it.

If every model in the first Antigravity scan was already known from other tools, usage now records that the scan took place. Later new models will no longer be treated as part of that first scan and will still be announced. ⟦Think of the roster as a shop's list of regulars: names already on the list used to get called out twice, while an unregistered new branch missed its new arrivals—now only genuine first-time visitors get announced.⟧

items.original:
**Quota-aware mode no longer announces a Codex model a second time when you first use it.** A model already recorded from the Codex catalog was announced again from your usage logs.
**New Antigravity models are announced even when every model in the first scan was already known from other tools.** usage did not record that Antigravity had been scanned, so later new models were treated as part of the first scan and not announced.

title.zh-TW: NO_PROXY 排除 Google 時離線不誤判
title.en: Offline check stays accurate when NO_PROXY excludes Google

body.zh-TW: 電腦有設 proxy（代理伺服器，轉接網路連線的中繼站），又把 Google 列進不走代理的 `NO_PROXY` 名單，離線時卻被當成已登出嗎？過去即使 Google 登入主機不經由代理連線，usage 只要看到有設代理就當成有網路，結果在離線時執行 Antigravity CLI，把你標成已登出。現在 Google 登入主機被 NO_PROXY 排除時，離線檢查也會正常運作。⟦就像櫃檯看到你掛了轉接分機就當作外線暢通，沒管直撥號碼不走總機，斷線時直接誤判你離席；現在走直撥也會正常檢查離線狀態。⟧
body.en: Have a proxy (an intermediary server that forwards network connections) configured with Google listed in `NO_PROXY` to bypass it, only to be marked signed out while offline? Previously, even when Google's sign-in host bypassed the proxy, usage assumed you were online just because a proxy was set, so running the Antigravity CLI offline could mark you as signed out. Now the offline check works properly when NO_PROXY excludes Google's sign-in host. ⟦Picture a front desk assuming your outside line works just because an extension is set to forward, ignoring that direct-dial numbers bypass the switchboard and marking you away when disconnected—now direct lines get checked for offline status properly too.⟧

items.original: **The offline check works when NO_PROXY excludes Google.** With a proxy set, usage assumed it was online even when Google's sign-in host bypassed the proxy, so it could run the Antigravity CLI while offline and mark you as signed out.

title.zh-TW: Codex 額度與分支對話不再錯算重讀
title.en: Codex quotas and forked sessions stop miscounting or rereading

body.zh-TW:
只是特定模型被擋下，主畫面的週用量卻跟著跳成滿格；從對話切出去的子工作階段也每次都被重頭讀過。

當 Codex Spark 或 premium 模型這類獨立額度拒絕請求時，卡片以前會把一般週額度也標成用完。現在只有一般 Codex 額度被拒，才會顯示成 100% 已用。

重開舊的 Codex 對話工作階段後如果被拒，卡片過去會停在那個舊讀數，跳過其他工作階段較新的額度。現在會先取最新的讀數，再套用被拒紀錄。

如果你有從對話分岔出去或交給子代理的工作階段，Codex 的磁碟快取（把算過的結果暫存起來直接用）過去每次存檔都會把它們丟掉。現在不會再漏存，也不用每次重新整理都重寫快取、重讀一次。
body.en:
A block on one specific model used to jump the main weekly usage to full, and child sessions branched off a conversation were reread from scratch every time.

When a separate limit such as Codex Spark or a premium model refused a request, the card used to mark the regular weekly quota as exhausted too. Now it only shows 100% used when the regular Codex limit is refused.

After a refusal in a reopened old Codex session, the card previously stayed on that old reading and skipped newer quota readings from other sessions. It now picks the newest reading first, then applies the refusal.

If you have forked sessions or sessions handed off to subagents, the Codex disk cache used to drop them every time it saved. They are no longer left out, avoiding rewriting the cache and rereading them on every refresh.

items.original:
**A refusal from a separate Codex limit no longer shows your regular Codex quota as 100% used.** When a dedicated limit such as Codex Spark or a premium model refused a request, the card marked the regular weekly window as full. Only a refusal of the regular Codex limit does that now.
**Reopening an old Codex session no longer hides newer quota from your other sessions.** After a refusal in a resumed old session, the card kept that session's old reading and skipped newer readings from other sessions. It now takes the newest reading, then applies the refusal.
**The Codex disk cache is no longer rewritten on every refresh when you have forked or subagent sessions.** Those sessions were dropped each time the cache was saved, so the cache was rewritten and they were read again.

title.zh-TW: 報表產生更快，記憶體不再久佔
title.en: Reports build faster without holding onto memory

body.zh-TW:
歷史紀錄越積越多，點開用量報表不只得等上一陣子，關掉後電腦記憶體還像被咬住一樣降不下來。

以前報表是在選單列或系統匣 app 裡直接產生，會把完整歷史再讀一次，讓 app 多佔約 150 MB 記憶體直到重開才會還。現在改由獨立行程產生報表，這個行程結束後就會釋放記憶體。

報表讀取速度也變快了，Claude Code 紀錄改成只讀一次，已刪除的專案資料夾也不再跑 git。一份大量歷史實測從 47 秒降到 32 秒，數字完全相同。⟦小店把算帳交給外包會計的工作室：以前厚帳本全攤在店裡櫃檯佔位子，現在帳在外面算完就收工，櫃檯立刻空出來。⟧
body.en:
As history grows, opening the usage report not only took a while, it also left your computer's memory stuck high even after closing it.

Previously, the report was built inside the menu bar or tray app, loading the full history a second time and adding about 150 MB of memory that stayed until restart. The report is now built in a separate process that frees the memory as soon as it exits.

Report loading is faster too: Claude Code logs are now read once instead of twice, and git no longer runs for deleted project folders. On one large history test, build time dropped from 47 to 32 seconds with identical numbers. ⟦A small shop now hands its bookkeeping to an outside accountant's studio: thick ledgers used to stay spread across the shop counter taking up space, whereas now the books are tallied off-site and the counter clears right away.⟧

items.original:
**Opening the report no longer leaves the menu bar or tray app about 150 MB larger.** The report was built inside the app, which loaded your full history a second time and kept that memory until restart. It is now built in a separate process that frees the memory when it exits.
**The report is built faster.** It reads Claude Code logs once instead of twice and no longer runs git for project folders that were deleted. On one large history it went from 47 to 32 seconds, with identical numbers.

title.zh-TW: 超過 30 天被刪的對話仍算活躍日
title.en: Conversations deleted after 30 days still count as active days

body.zh-TW: 每天都在用 Claude Code，回頭看報表的連續天數卻莫名其妙斷在一個月前。Claude Code 預設會在 30 天後刪除對話檔，以前那些日子就被當成沒用過，讓活躍日與連續天數跟著斷掉。現在這兩項都會算進去，熱力圖會用最淺的顏色標示。附錄也改名為「數字怎麼算的」，並在「沒算到的用量」底下把這些日期列出來。⟦跟紙本打卡單滿一個月就碎掉一樣，以前單子一銷毀就把出勤天數歸零，現在總表上仍用淡色補記一筆，全勤紀錄不會平白中斷。⟧
body.en: You use Claude Code every day, yet the streak in your report mysteriously stops a month ago. Claude Code deletes conversation files after 30 days by default, so those days used to count as unused, breaking both your active days and your streak. Now both are counted, and the heatmap marks them in its lightest shade. The appendix is also renamed to "How the numbers are calculated" and lists those dates under "Usage not included". ⟦Paper timecards used to get shredded after a month, resetting attendance counts to zero when the slips were destroyed, whereas the master sheet now adds a faint mark so a perfect attendance record is not broken for no reason.⟧

items.original: **Days you used Claude Code count as active in the report even when their conversation files are gone.** Claude Code deletes conversation files after 30 days by default, so those days counted as idle and broke your streak. Active days and streaks now count them, and the heatmap shows them in its lightest shade. The appendix, now titled "How the numbers are calculated", lists those dates under "Usage not included".

title.zh-TW: 斜線指令派工對話在報表顯示正常標題
title.en: Slash-command dispatch conversations show proper titles in the report

body.zh-TW: 翻舊紀錄想找先前派出去的任務，畫面上卻冒出「<local-command-caveat>The command below」這串字。過去根本看不出那次在忙什麼，現在用斜線指令開頭的派工對話，報表都會顯示正常的標題。
body.en: When you look through old records to find a task you previously dispatched, text like "<local-command-caveat>The command below" appears on screen. It used to be impossible to tell what that run was doing, whereas dispatch conversations starting with a slash command now display proper titles in the report.

items.original: **Dispatch conversations started with a slash command get a real title in the report** instead of text like "<local-command-caveat>The command below".

title.zh-TW: 5 小時選項改名，工作階段改稱計時器
title.en: 5-hour option renamed, changing Session to timer

body.zh-TW: 設定選單裡有個選項排在「登入時啟動」正下方，看名字常讓人以為是第二個開機啟動開關。它負責的是在額度重置後立刻開始 5 小時計時器。原名「Auto-start 5-hour Session」改為「Auto-start 5-hour timer」，名稱中的「工作階段」換成「計時器」。實際行為和你的既有設定都不會改變。
body.en: In the settings menu, an option sits right below "Launch at login", and its name often made it look like a second startup toggle. What it actually does is start the 5-hour timer right after a quota reset. Originally named "Auto-start 5-hour Session", it is renamed to "Auto-start 5-hour timer", replacing "Session" with "timer" in the name. Actual behavior and your existing settings remain unchanged.

items.original: **Auto-start 5-hour Session is renamed Auto-start 5-hour timer.** It sat under Launch at login and read like a second launch option; it starts the 5-hour timer right after a reset. Behavior and settings are unchanged.

title.zh-TW: Codex 額度用完被拒改顯示 100%
title.en: Codex Shows 100% After Quota Refusal

body.zh-TW:
明明額度耗盡被 Codex 擋下來了，用量卡片卻還停在幾小時前的 99%，旁邊甚至掛著「約 N 小時前更新」？現在的 Codex CLI（用文字指令操作的工具）被拒後不再記下額度，卡片才一直停在最後一筆舊讀數。

現在只要有比這筆讀數更新的拒絕紀錄，被拒的那個額度窗口就會顯示 100% 已用。原本的重置時間照舊，資料新舊改從被拒那一刻算起。那個窗口重置後，卡片會回到正常讀數，不會把 100% 移到另一個窗口。

就算別的工作階段（也就是另外開的對話）比較晚修改，卡片一樣找得到另一個工作階段裡的拒絕紀錄。⟦跟信用卡刷爆被退件一樣，以前沒刷成就不記帳，帳上看起來還剩一點額度；現在只要被退刷過，這期就改標全滿，等重置後才恢復正常。⟧
body.en:
Ever get blocked by Codex after running out of quota, only for the usage card to stay stuck at 99% from hours earlier, even showing "about N hours ago" beside it? Current Codex CLI (a tool operated via text commands) no longer logs quota after a refusal, so the card kept sitting on the last old reading.

Now, whenever there is a refusal record newer than that reading, the refused quota window shows 100% used. Its original reset time stays the same, and the data's age now counts from the moment of refusal. Once that window resets, the card returns to normal readings instead of moving the 100% to the other window.

Even if a different session (a separately opened conversation) was modified more recently, the card still finds the refusal record in another session. ⟦Picture maxing out a credit card and it getting declined: before, a failed charge went unlogged so the statement still looked like it had a little room left; now, any declined attempt marks the period as full until it resets.⟧

items.original: **The Codex card shows 100% used once Codex refuses a request for hitting its limit.** Current Codex CLI no longer logs quota after a refused run, so the card kept the last reading, such as 99% from hours earlier, with an "about N hours ago" warning. A refusal newer than that reading now marks the refused window as 100% used, keeps its reset time, and counts the data's age from the refusal. Once that window resets, the card goes back to the normal reading instead of moving the 100% to the other window. A refusal in another session is found even when a different session was modified more recently.

title.zh-TW: 狀態列按鈕也設定 Antigravity 與 Grok
title.en: Status Line Button Also Sets Up Antigravity and Grok

body.zh-TW:
裝好 Antigravity 或 Grok CLI 後按了「設定狀態列」，這兩個工具的狀態列（顯示在終端機最底下的資訊列）以前不會當場裝上。過去這顆按鈕只設定 Claude Code，其餘兩個 CLI 得等下次重開應用程式，或把狀態列開關關掉再打開才會生效。

現在只要有裝這兩個 CLI，在 macOS 與 Windows 按下按鈕都會立刻設定好。⟦好比逛遊樂園買聯票，以前在入口蓋一次章只放行主園區，另外兩館得等下次入園或出場重進才能逛；現在只要館區有開，一蓋章就當場放行。⟧
body.en:
After installing the Antigravity or Grok CLI and clicking "Set Up Status Line", the status line (the info bar at the very bottom of the terminal) for these two tools previously would not install on the spot. In the past, that button only set up Claude Code, while the other two CLIs had to wait until the next app relaunch or for you to toggle the status line switch off and back on.

Now, as long as those two CLIs are installed, pressing the button on macOS and Windows sets them up right away. ⟦Think of buying a multi-park theme park pass: before, one stamp at the entrance only let you into the main park while the other two pavilions waited until your next visit or re-entry; now, as long as a pavilion is open, a single stamp lets you in on the spot.⟧

items.original: **The Set Up Status Line button now also sets up the Antigravity and Grok status lines.** The button only set up Claude Code; the Antigravity and Grok CLI status lines were added on the next app launch or by turning the status line switch off and on. They are now set up right away when those CLIs are installed, on macOS and Windows.

title.zh-TW: 刪除私有或內部儲存庫前會再確認 fork
title.en: Confirming forks again before deleting private or internal repositories

body.zh-TW:
清理不再維護的 GitHub 儲存庫，不少人習慣在 `gh repo delete` 後面補上 `--yes` 直接跳過確認。現在要刪的如果是私有或內部儲存庫，而且會一併刪掉底下的 fork（從原儲存庫另外複製出去的獨立副本），指令就會先跳出警告。這時你得再確認一次，就算已經加上 `--yes` 也一樣。

如果是沒有人手輸入的非互動式流程或代理程式，執行刪除就必須明確加上同意連帶刪除的參數：

```shell
gh repo delete OWNER/REPO --yes --accept-cascading-deletion-of-private-forks
```

⟦就像管理員要關掉大樓的總電源，以前只要拿到授權單就直接斷電，現在發現線路還接著其他人的設備，就會先暫停並要求再確認，連自動排程也得另外寫明同意一併斷電。⟧
body.en:
When cleaning up unmaintained GitHub repositories, many people add `--yes` after `gh repo delete` to skip confirmation. Now, if the repository you are deleting is private or internal and will also delete its forks (independent copies made from the original repository), the command warns you first. You then have to confirm a second time, even if you already passed `--yes`.

For non-interactive workflows or agents without manual input, running the deletion requires explicitly adding the flag that accepts cascading deletion:

```shell
gh repo delete OWNER/REPO --yes --accept-cascading-deletion-of-private-forks
```

⟦Picture a building manager shutting off the main power: previously, an authorization slip was enough to cut it right away, but now if the lines still feed other people's equipment, the process pauses for a second confirmation—and even automated schedules must separately state they agree to cut power to those as well.⟧

items.original:
## Protect private forks when deleting repositories

`gh repo delete` now warns when deleting a private or internal repository will also delete its forks. The additional confirmation is required even with `--yes`.

Non-interactive workflows and agents must explicitly accept the cascading deletion:

```shell
gh repo delete OWNER/REPO --yes --accept-cascading-deletion-of-private-forks
```

title.zh-TW: --attach 憑證檢查延後至上傳端點並由伺服器裁定 GitHub App 權限
title.en: Defer `--attach` Credential Checks to Upload Endpoint and Let Server Arbitrate GitHub App Permissions

body.zh-TW: 在自動化流程中使用 GitHub CLI 發布內容時，若想隨附測試日誌或建置成品，通常會使用 `--attach` 參數打包檔案。⟦就像去快遞站寄送特殊包裹，以前臨櫃店員只要在清單上找不到對應代號就當場拒收，現在門市先將包裹轉交後端物流中心，由總部依照權限統一核對資格。⟧過去命令列工具會在終端機本機端提前檢查身分，容易直接攔下自動化工具的上傳請求。現在 GitHub CLI 將 `--attach` 的憑證檢查延後到上傳端點處理。GitHub 伺服器端會直接裁定哪些 GitHub App 的安裝權杖（token，向伺服器驗證身分的授權令牌）具備附加檔案的權限。使用 GitHub App 執行排程任務時，能否附加檔案，改由 GitHub 伺服器裁定；`--attach` 的憑證檢查則延後到上傳端點處理。
body.en: When publishing content in automated workflows using GitHub CLI, if you want to include test logs or build artifacts, you typically use the `--attach` flag to bundle files. ⟦Picture sending a special package at a courier station: counter clerks previously rejected parcels on the spot whenever a matching code was missing from their list, but now the station forwards packages to the backend logistics center so headquarters can centrally verify eligibility based on permissions.⟧ Previously, the command-line tool checked credentials early on the local terminal side, easily blocking upload requests from automated tools outright. Now, GitHub CLI defers `--attach` credential checks to the upload endpoint. The GitHub server directly arbitrates which GitHub App installation tokens (authorization credentials used to verify identity with the server) have permission to attach files. When running scheduled tasks with a GitHub App, whether files can be attached is decided by the GitHub server; `--attach` credential checks are deferred to the upload endpoint.

items.original:
Allow server to arbitrate which GitHub App installation tokens can attach files by @martinajir in [#14804](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14804)
Defer `--attach` credential checks to the upload endpoint by @BagToad in [#14805](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14805)

title.zh-TW: `gh` 可改用會自動續期的登入憑證（預覽）
title.en: `gh` can sign in with auto-refreshing credentials (preview)

body.zh-TW:
一般用 `gh` 登入 GitHub，拿到的 token（證明你身分的授權令牌）發下來就不會過期。現在可以改選會過期的 OAuth 憑證：`gh` 會存一把短效的 access token，另配一把會輪替的 refresh token（專門用來換新令牌的憑證）。access token 需要時會自動換新，你不必重新登入。⟦公司門禁卡改成每天自動換發的臨時卡，以前一張卡用到離職，現在卡片天天換新，你照樣每天刷卡進門。⟧這是預覽功能，要自己選擇開啟。只想這一次登入用它，打：

```shell
gh auth login --expiring
```

想以後每次登入都優先用它，打：

```shell
gh config set expiring_credentials enabled
```
body.en:
Normally, signing in to GitHub with `gh` gives you a token (the pass that proves who you are) that never expires. You can now opt into expiring OAuth credentials instead: `gh` stores a short-lived access token alongside a rotating refresh token (a credential used only to get a new pass). The access token is refreshed automatically whenever needed, so you stay signed in without authenticating again. ⟦An office swapped its permanent badges for temporary ones reissued every day: you used to keep one badge until you left the company, and now it renews daily while you still just tap in each morning.⟧ This is a preview you have to opt into. To use it for a single sign-in, run:

```shell
gh auth login --expiring
```

To prefer expiring credentials for every sign-in, run:

```shell
gh config set expiring_credentials enabled
```

items.original:
## Expiring, auto-refreshing OAuth tokens (preview)

`gh` can now sign in with expiring OAuth credentials that it refreshes automatically. When you opt in, `gh` stores a short-lived access token alongside a rotating refresh token and refreshes the access token whenever it is needed, so you stay signed in without having to authenticate again.

To opt in for a single sign-in, run:

```shell
gh auth login --expiring
```

To prefer expiring credentials for every sign-in, run:

```shell
gh config set expiring_credentials enabled
```

title.zh-TW: 用會過期的 `gh` 憑證時，查狀態、接 git 和寫腳本要注意的事
title.en: Living with expiring `gh` credentials: status, git and scripts

body.zh-TW: 開了自動續期後，想知道憑證還剩多久，就打 `gh auth status`：它會顯示憑證能不能續期、access token 何時到期。它和 `gh auth token` 都會在需要時自動續期。github.com 和 GHE.com 支援這種 token，其他主機會退回一般不過期的 token。git 走 HTTPS 的話，建議用 git 2.46 以上，並執行 `gh auth setup-git`，讓 `gh` 當 git 的 credential helper（替 git 提供登入資料的程式）。這樣 git 不會把憑證留到過期之後。⟦跟鮮奶一樣，以前能囤一箱慢慢喝，現在得隨喝隨買。⟧腳本和擴充別把 `gh auth token` 的輸出存起來，每次要用都重新執行它；透過 `GH_TOKEN` 或 `GITHUB_TOKEN` 給的 token 則永遠不會續期。
body.en: Once expiring credentials are on, you may want to know how long yours has left. `gh auth status` shows whether a credential is refreshable and when the current access token expires, and both `gh auth status` and `gh auth token` refresh the access token automatically when needed. Expiring tokens are available on github.com and GHE.com; on hosts that do not issue them, `gh` falls back to a regular non-expiring token. If git talks to GitHub over HTTPS, the advice is to use git 2.46 or newer and run `gh auth setup-git` so `gh` acts as git's credential helper (the program that hands git its sign-in details).
